title: A modal holds the page behind it still, and lets go when it closes

backendBuild.detail: the in-repo fixture backend, not an API build (branch HEAD)

steps.name: ask for an admin page while signed out
steps.detail: redirected to ?redirect=%2Fadmin%2Flang with the login modal open

steps.name: THE LOGIN MODAL HOLDS THE LOCK, and keeps holding it across a head update
steps.detail: body class "noscroll", overflow hidden; nothing scrollable behind the login screen (doc 720px vs viewport 720px)

steps.name: sign in and land on the page that was asked for
steps.detail: on /admin/lang, 4662px of page in a 720px viewport; lock released

steps.name: with no modal open, a wheel moves the page — the control
open a modal, and the wheel stops moving the page
steps.detail: body hidden; wheel 600 then 3000 left the page at 1200

steps.name: a navigation with the modal still open does not release it
steps.detail: after $router.replace the body is still "noscroll" and the page has not moved

steps.name: closing one of two open modals does not release the lock
steps.detail: two modals -> closed one -> body still "noscroll", page still at 1200

steps.name: closing the last one releases it, and the wheel works again
steps.detail: lock released, page resumed at 1199 and wheeled to 1799

findings.summary: EditLangRowModal does not act on the Modal close event
findings.detail: components/organisms/EditLangRowModal.vue wraps atoms/Modal but binds no @close, so Escape runs Modal.close() and nothing happens — the modal can only be dismissed with Avbryt. Pre-existing, unrelated to the scroll lock, and not fixed by this lane; noticed while driving the journey.
